files.purpose: Pin the Jac web entry and server codespace.

Implement deterministic brief_monday(now: date | datetime | None) -> date, brief_day_index(now: date | datetime | None) -> int, and brief_week_label(now: date | datetime | None) -> str. Expose a small public walker for the page to request a date preview.
Style the date input, preview, and clear status text.
Show the current brief week, accept a chosen date, call the service walker, and render its observed response.
Register the service walker and mount the planner at the home route.

verify.steps: Run the original brief_dates behavior tests; open the home page, choose a weekday and a weekend date, and verify their Monday and day index. Check the empty/default state.

assumption: The build starts in an empty Jac 0.34.27 workspace; no external AI service is needed.
